rows.note: Use this colloquial pattern when someone refuses to obey a particular person’s instructions.

example.english: The kid often chooses to defy his mother.
example.traditional: 個細路仔成日唔聽阿媽話。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 seng4 jat6 m4 teng1 aa3 maa1 waa6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for challenging a person, authority, opponent, or danger.

example.english: I dare to defy this obstacle.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gau3 daam2 tiu1 zin3 ni1 go3 naan4 gwaan1

rows.note: Use this when something goes against a rule, requirement, or established pattern.

example.english: Doing this would defy the company rules.
example.traditional: 咁樣做就違反公司規定喇。
example.jyutping: gam2 joeng6 zou6 zau6 wai4 faan2 gung1 si1 kwai1 ding6 laa3

rows.note: Use this, especially in more formal contexts, when something goes against expectations, principles, or an intention.

example.english: This decision seems to defy our long-held principles.
example.traditional: 呢個決定違背咗我哋一向嘅原則。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 wai4 bui3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 jat1 hoeng3 ge3 jyun4 zak1
